refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns SNMP object value on success or &false; on error. If object_id is a string, the value is a string (or an object with type and value properties, depending on snmp_set_valueretrieval). If it is an array, an associative array is returned, whose keys are the OIDs as formatted by snmp_set_oid_output_format, not the keys that were passed in; duplicate OIDs are merged. If only some of the OIDs cannot be read, the array holds the others and an E_WARNING is emitted; &false; is returned only when all of them fail.

&reftitle.errors;
Throws a ValueError if:
the hostname contains null bytes, or is 128 bytes or longer.
the port in the hostname is greater than 65535 or negative.
the security_name is empty or contains null bytes.
timeout is lower than -1.
retries is lower than -1 or greater than INT_MAX.
object_id is an empty array.
security_level is not one of noAuthNoPriv, authNoPriv or authPriv (or their short forms nanp, anp and ap).
auth_protocol or privacy_protocol is not a supported protocol.
These checks are done before any network access.
